criteria.criterion: AC1: a job whose annotation says it exceeded its maximum execution time renders as timed out, naming the job and its duration; unit test asserts the text.
AC2: timed out, cancelled-without-annotation, and failed render with different wording; unit tests cover all three.
AC3: an all-successful payload returns "", so a `+1` run posts no comment; unit test.

AC4: the summary is posted by an SSH `gerrit review --message` step passing no `--label` (casting neither Verified nor Code-Review), guarded on vote-type != `success`; a test parses the workflow and fails if `--label`, `Verified=` or `Code-Review=` appears there.
AC5: the cast step's `vote-type` still reads `steps.normalize.outputs.vote-type`, and `normalize` is unchanged; asserted by a test.
AC7: both new steps are `continue-on-error` and ordered after the cast; asserted by tests, so a fault in the comment path leaves the vote already cast.
AC8: a job name containing a single quote cannot escape the remote command's quoting; unit test feeds a hostile shard name through `summarize()`.

AC9: the SSH step uses port 29418, installs the key with `chmod 600` plus `known_hosts`, validates change/patchset against `^[1-9][0-9]*$`, and removes the key in an `if: always()` step; asserted by tests parsing the workflow.

AC10: the summarize step fetches this run's jobs from `actions/runs/<id>/jobs` and per-job annotations from `check-runs/<id>/annotations`, passing them as `JOBS_JSON` / `ANNOTATIONS_JSON`; asserted by tests parsing the workflow.
Bug 'Verified -1 from a cancelled or timed-out job carries no triage signal' is actually resolved: the reported defect no longer reproduces and expected behavior holds.
